name: Assistance to Farmers in Purchasing Nano Fertilizers Under the Agricultural Assistance Program for Farmers Other than Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes
benefit: - Up to 50% of the purchased price per hectare or ₹750/- (within a maximum limit of 4 hectares per account.
_eligibility_text:
- The applicant must be a farmer.
  - The applicant must belong to the General category (i.e., not SC or ST).
  - The applicant must be a resident of Gujarat.
